RRB ALP CBT-II Answer Key 2026

Post Date: August 6, 2026

4:50 pm

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB), has released the CBT-II Answer Key on its official website for the recruitment of Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) posts. The exam was conducted on 28 July 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 19 May 2025. Candidates can check their CBT-II Answer Key using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct links are provided below. (CEN – 01/2025)
